UC-1185.note: Row of a page looked at online that couldn't open, the site and a plain reason ("Couldn't open livelaw.in: the site refused."); no Failed mark. Was told as failed: the row "Tried to read <site> online." with the Failed mark, the folded line "1 failed." (Windows tester item C).

UC-1186.note: Row of such a page when the error says nothing we can name. Was told as failed: the row "Tried to read <site> online." with the Failed mark, the folded line "1 failed." (Windows tester item C).

UC-1187.note: Row of such a page when no site is known. Was told as failed: the row "Tried to read <site> online." with the Failed mark, the folded line "1 failed." (Windows tester item C).

UC-1188.note: Row of such a page with neither site nor reason known. Was told as failed: the row "Tried to read <site> online." with the Failed mark, the folded line "1 failed." (Windows tester item C).

UC-1189.note: Reason in the row: HTTP 401, 403, 407, 429 or 451 ("The server returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.").

UC-1190.note: Reason in the row: HTTP 404 or 410.

UC-1191.note: Reason in the row: the page is over the fetch's size limit (10 MB, "maxContentLength … exceeded").

UC-1192.note: Reason in the row: DNS failure, refused or reset connection, certificate error, or HTTP 5xx.

UC-1193.note: Reason in the row: the fetch timed out.

UC-1194.note: Folded line, muted beside the summary (or the line itself when nothing else ran): one page couldn't open. Replaces "1 failed." for such pages.

UC-1195.note: Folded line: pages that couldn't open, counted. Replaces "{n} failed." for such pages ("6 failed" on the Windows tester's card).

UC-1196.en: 1 held back by Claude's safety check.
UC-1196.note: Folded line, muted: a read, listing or look online that Claude's auto mode safety check refused before it ran (e.g. a folder listing on Windows). An edit, deletion, move or command it refused stays in the trouble line as failed. Replaces "1 failed." for it.

UC-1197.en: {n} held back by Claude's safety check.
UC-1197.note: Folded line, muted: such steps counted. Replaces "{n} failed." for them.

UC-1198.en: Held back by Claude's safety check
UC-1198.note: Row mark, after the step's words, for a step Claude's auto mode safety check refused or couldn't judge (refusals.ts kinds check and no_verdict); the line under it says why. A step Clauseo's own off-limits rule refused reads "Clauseo keeps this off limits" (UC-1271). Replaces the Failed mark.
